observations_and_findings.mechanism: Build merges and resolves fragments then requires the shared validator before emitting the catalog. Each family or surname selection weight must be positive and uniquely eligible, and every derived target must match its individual score, but those family-per-sex and surname groups are not summed in the validator. In contrast, form frequencies are checked-add accumulated per family. Under a hypothetical otherwise valid reachable group containing weights u64::MAX and 1, rand 0.9.5 WeightedIndex checks accumulation and returns Overflow; deterministic wrapper maps WeightOverflow, generator maps that to NameCatalogError::Sampling(String), and the selected starting-character helper expects successful generation.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Authoring files → aggregate/fragment merge → build validator → embedded catalog → selected identity/render/sampler paths are scoped; remaining corpus and downstream persistence paths stay open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Culture, Sex, CalendarYear, register and name IDs have explicit owners; relative weights and source counts are semantically different. Existing ID wrappers are raw String backed and membership remains contextual.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Strict Serde products are raw until aggregate validation. Source linkage, IDs, intervals, eligible forms and derivations have scoped gates; family/surname sampler totals are a conditional admitted-input gap.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Per-family form addition is checked; weighted family and surname totals must satisfy native checked accumulation. Derivation coverage subtraction is bounded by successful target insertion.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Repertoire culture/tradition/year and linked family/form/surname/provenance records require relations. One-field positivity does not establish aggregate weight or final display suitability.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Canonical semantic ID owners and SamplingError exist; assess source/repertoire namespaces and validate-vs-render error owners before moving authority.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Per-entry target score duplicates authored selection score but equality is checked by derivation; observation count and relative score are deliberately distinct, not automatically two competing authorities.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Retain partial source documents, fragment resolution, valid unsorted authoring semantics, valid inclusive selector behavior, deterministic selection, explicit fallible errors, and authored/unresolved modes when deciding repairs.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: Record unit, tradition, register and surname class are closed enums; derivation three optional target fields admit three shapes through a validator, and any enum conversion must preserve actual authoring boundary semantics.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Serde derives and defaults support partial authoring, while RenderedPersonalName has custom deserialize through its checked constructor. No mechanical derive substitution or wire guarantee is justified here.
thirteen_lenses.type-granularity: Name family, form and surname identities are distinct; source counts, family/form/surname relative weights and display names must not be collapsed merely because their primitive representations match.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Authorial title, spelling, rationale, URL and notes are open evidence; ID grammar, internal validation String errors and seed namespace literals are separate boundary/ownership questions.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: u64 weight width, per-group accumulation, <=160 Unicode character display bound and field-specific positivity have distinct owners. No assumption that all counts or partial source records require positivity.
